what: Trust administration opens. Date of death fixes step-up basis (FMV) and Prop 13/19 evaluation date.
Secure Property A; confirm HO-3 / vacancy coverage; notify insurer, utilities, assessor.
Order written valuation of A at date of death (basis + Prop 19 evidence).
Complete estate inventory (Data page); title report on A (liens/debt Q10).
File Form 706 if estate > $15M (2026) or to elect portability; Form 4768 by month 9 for +6 months to file.
File homeowners' exclusion ≤1 year of transfer; exclusion claim ≤3 years (or before transfer to third party).
Model sale in the same tax year first: step-up ⇒ ~$0 gain; transfer tax + selling cost still apply.
Live / rent / sell per pre-commitment (Suggestions S1); log decision + date (decision log).
Park proceeds in 3M-2Y Treasuries 24-36 months, then phase into stocks over 24 months (default).
Full FMV reassessment applies (no Prop 19); obtain comps first (rent path is a floor until then).
Re-run model every January; recheck IRS/BOE/FTB/SF/SCC sources; review black swans.
